title.zh: 依第 411 条出具的紧急证明

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-4-2014-CERTIFICATION-OF-URGENCY-UNDER-ARTICLE-411.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 1 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en:
Constitution of certifies the Bandar Seri Begawan, Supply (2014/2015) Bill, 2014. to Brunei Darussalam. hereby of Jamadilawal, 1435 Hijriah corresponding WIJAYA the Yang Di-Pertuan Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI 41(1) Article 41(1) of THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pengarah Percetakan, Negara

DARUSSALAM ARTICLE Iman, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, UNDER Nurul dan HIS MAJESTY BRUNEI the Harga B$5.00 by Sultan URGENCY of Istana conferred respect OF CONSTITUTION the Our OF Brunei Darussalam, His Majesty in CERTIFICATE power urgency at day of March, 2014 the is a case of 1st. exercise of Brunei Darussalam. this Jabatan Dated there day S4 In di No. that 3rd.
